Oceanic Services Ltd. | Demonstration dataset | Version 1.0
1. Purpose and scope
This handbook describes general workplace policies for the fictional company Oceanic Services Ltd. It applies to
shore-based employees and vessel crew unless a section states otherwise. Where a signed employment
agreement or applicable law provides a more specific or more protective requirement, that requirement takes
precedence.
2. Working hours and attendance
Standard shore-office hours are 09:30 to 18:00, Monday through Friday, with a one-hour meal break. Vessel crew
working hours are determined by the approved vessel roster and operational requirements. Employees must
record attendance using the company attendance system or the vessel's approved log.
Employees who expect to be late or absent must notify their reporting manager as soon as reasonably possible
